acceptance_criteria: Fresh full production file backup and direct MySQL backup are created, hashed, and restored locally before production writes.
Apply AddGithubActivityEventTimes directly to production only after backup/restore succeeds; verify migration ledger, merged_at/closed_at columns and existing data counts.
